changelog:
- NoVery Group Pool Integration: Added NoVery group pool support to the local order form for offline post reaction orders.
- Reaction Type Restrictions: Restricted NoVery orders strictly to Reaction actions (Like, Love, Haha, Wow, Sad, Angry) while excluding CARE reactions.
- Maximum Order Capacity Cap: Added an automatic quantity limit of 300 per order to ensure smooth processing.
- Web API Forwarding: Integrated seamless forwarding of NoVery orders via secure Clawd Web API with discrete status reporting.
